name: lava-lamp
title: Lava Lamp
description: Raymarched metaball blobs rendered with a smooth-min SDF and Fresnel edge lighting. Creates a fluid, organic lava lamp animation. Lit Custom Element.

usage.label: Astro
usage.code:
---
import "@/components/motion-kit/lava-lamp-element.ts";
---

<motion-lava-lamp
  color="#17181A"
  fresnel-color="#ff6900"
  speed="1.0"
  fresnel-power="3.0"
  radius="1"
  smoothness="0.1"
  class="w-full h-[500px]"
/>

usage.label: HTML
usage.code:
<script type="module" src="/components/motion-kit/lava-lamp-element.js"></script>

<motion-lava-lamp
  color="#17181A"
  fresnel-color="#ff6900"

props.name: color
props.description: Base body color of the lava blobs.

props.name: fresnel-color
props.description: Color applied at blob edges via the Fresnel effect.

props.name: fresnel-power
props.description: Controls the sharpness of the Fresnel edge glow.

props.name: smoothness
props.description: Smoothness of the blob blending (metaball merge factor).

props.name: scale
props.description: Scale multiplier for the lava field.

props.name: offset-x
props.description: Horizontal offset in normalized viewport units.

props.name: offset-y
props.description: Vertical offset in normalized viewport units.
